subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept the shared session-scoped `/stream` command with `SessionEntry.streamingMode` and the `previewStreamingSessionOverride` channel capability for Telegram, Discord, and Slack after the rebase fixes?
rationale: The code is a new cross-channel user command, persisted session state, and plugin capability contract; automation can identify the rebase defect, but maintainers need to approve the permanent product/API shape.

options.title: Accept after rebase and proof
options.body: Approve this direction once the branch preserves current session persistence conflict handling and includes redacted live channel proof for the visible command path.

options.title: Narrow or defer the command surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller or plugin-owned design if maintainers do not want a shared core `/stream` command and session capability yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Approve this direction once the branch preserves current session persistence conflict handling and includes redacted live channel proof for the visible command path.
